taskBaseInfo.taskDescription: G1 regression check for the X1 branch: same entry script, image and branch as x1-supermimic-plumbing-60 but --robot g1, 40 iterations / 512 envs. Tests that the upstream G1 code path (mjlab G1 entity, G1_ACTION_SCALE, TRACKED_BODIES, the 'tracked' joint-weight table, MotionLibrary) still builds and trains after the X1 changes. Fed the X1 library because the repo ships no G1 library, so returns are not meaningful -- this is a path test, not a G1 result.
